title: Model gateway signing key moves to SSM SecureString (development only)
description: Part of story chatticus-a170754a (Secrets and generated keys live in SSM Parameter Store SecureString, created by infrastructure code); read its description for the full plan, order and hazards. ModelGatewaySigningKey in infra/lib/control-plane-stack.ts (isDevelopment only) becomes /chatticus/development/model-gateway/signing-key via the construct. Readers: FrontDoor, ComputerStarter, OwnerCredentialBroker (conversation/src/lambdas, 15 s cache in the broker). Rotate rather than copy (development only, no customers; rotation stops running owners, the documented last-resort cost) or a one-off owner-run pipe from secretsmanager to ssm before deploy, never printed. Old construct has removalPolicy DESTROY: remove it in a later deploy than the consumer switch. Add negative rows to role-access-manifest.json and simulate-role-access so owner supervisor and per-turn roles are denied the parameter. Rewrite docs/OWNER_CREDENTIAL_REVOCATION.md section 5 and the rotation story chatticus-541dc7; SSM history keeps old versions readable (deny GetParameterHistory or delete and recreate).
